chapter: Looking back and the lean years
title: A Royal Sonesta engagement in New Orleans that never repeated
summary: His band with Kenny Davern and Buzzy Drootin plays three or four weeks against the Dukes of Dixieland, then the policy changes.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Oh, yes but before all this colored/ white thing was resolved - you know and I mean these are some of the little trials and tribulations about having a band at that time. And, then-- I've taken bands now for instance - I'd get a call from - this was another call from the Glager office - sent me down to the Royal Sonesta Hotel down in --

New Orleans and I had Kenny Davern - Johnny Giuffrida, Chuck Folds, Ed Hubble, Buzzy Drootin, I had a fantastic band and it was against - there were two bands - there were the Dukes of Dixie Land and ourselves and it was a hell of a job and the leader got a nice big room - and everything and we stayed there about three weeks or four weeks with a promise to come back - with a lot of money. We never went back, because they changed the policy. You know, and these are the kind of things I was up against

all the time and this is why I started to rent myself out, calling the booking offices and saying - look, I don't have a band together, if you want me to put a band together I will, but why can't you put me with somebody - which they did and they started to do that.
